key_insight: Hierarchical quantum error correction can organize decoding within a single code or across code levels, with distinct throughput, latency, and coordination trade-offs.
engineering_relevance: Practical fault-tolerant systems must match decoder algorithms, execution hardware, and qubit timing requirements to deliver corrections fast enough.
method: Distinguish decoder-level hierarchy from code-level hierarchy.
Review cascaded, windowed, streaming, and distributed decoding, plus information exchange across code levels.
Compare CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC, and cryogenic decoding platforms.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a literature review of performance under reported evaluation conditions, not a new benchmark or quantified speedup.
watch_item: Gaps in performance reporting and system integration limit direct comparisons and confidence in end-to-end scalability.
paper_title: Hierarchical Decoding for Quantum Error Correction
